whenToUse: Files attached to a record: contracts on a deal, employee documents, post downloads.
A compact list with download, preview and remove actions.
avoidWhen: Browsing and managing a whole file store — use Media library.
Uploading new files — pair with or use File upload.
a11y: Each row's actions name the file (Download contract.pdf).
File type is given in text, not only by the tinted icon.
